items.title: Wild Tom in Profile
items.alt: A full adult wild tom facing left with folded tail, long neck, visible snood and sturdy three-toed feet.
items.description: A full adult wild tom facing left with folded tail, long neck, visible snood and sturdy three-toed feet. Suitable for nature-study worksheet.

items.title: Fan-Tail Front View
items.alt: A standing turkey faces forward with a symmetrical fanned tail, correct two legs and chest feathers.
items.description: A standing turkey faces forward with a symmetrical fanned tail, correct two legs and chest feathers. Suitable for classroom poster.

items.title: Strutting Tom
items.alt: A tom in three-quarter view struts with lowered wing tips, broad fan and puffed body.
items.description: A tom in three-quarter view struts with lowered wing tips, broad fan and puffed body. Suitable for seasonal invitations.
